offering_description.value: SmartStop rents self-storage units to households and businesses at facilities it owns and operates in the United States and Canada. It also manages self-storage facilities for other owners and sells moving and packing supplies to tenants.

primary_services.value: Self-storage unit rentals; self-storage property management

customer_segment.value: B2C: Households storing furniture, personal belongings and other goods; B2B: Businesses storing inventory, equipment or records and self-storage property owners seeking management

end_markets.value: Household self-storage; commercial self-storage; self-storage real estate

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Monthly rent for self-storage units; commissions or management fees: Operating self-storage properties for other owners; product sales: Locks, boxes and packing supplies sold to tenants
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; commissions or management fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Acquires and operates self-storage facilities and rents units to households and businesses; service provider: Manages self-storage facilities on behalf of property owners; retailer: Sells locks and packing supplies to storage customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Self-storage rentals, property management and moving supplies

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Staffed self-storage facilities; online: Company website for finding, reserving and renting units; direct sales: Telephone reservations through company staff

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State and provincial self-storage lien rules, local zoning and U.S. REIT tax requirements
